brief.goal: Implement spec/phase12/web-edge-policy.md EP1-EP9 as one complete vertical over the existing authenticated command/session/SSE authority. Start red-first. Add strict canonical direct/trusted-proxy address and forwarded-HTTPS resolution; deterministic bounded fixed-window address/login/principal/weighted-command quotas; refusal before provider/body/admission/dispatch; Retry-After and fail-closed audit; non-disclosing health/readiness; and bounded idempotent graceful shutdown that closes admission/streams/listener without touching worker lifecycle.
constraints: Edit only: impl/src/web-edge.mjs, impl/src/web-northbound.mjs, impl/src/web-stream.mjs, impl/src/index.mjs, impl/test/phase12-web-edge.test.mjs, impl/test/phase12-web-session-lifecycle.test.mjs, impl/test/phase12-web-auth.test.mjs, impl/test/phase12-web-northbound.test.mjs, impl/test/phase12-web-stream.test.mjs.
Use Node built-ins only; no dependencies.
Do not trust any forwarding header unless the immediate socket peer exactly matches configured trusted proxies.
Never audit/store raw client addresses; use a keyed digest and coarse class only.
Address quota must run before body/provider work; principal/cost quota before durable command admission.
Health/readiness return no fleet, repo, path, credential, provider, or dependency details.
Shutdown must never call coordinator interrupt/kill or claim worker death.
Preserve all existing Phase 12 behavior and tests.
Do not add OIDC, WebSocket, UI/browser automation, MCP, or homelab integration.
Do not commit, push, or use network tools.
brief.definitionOfDone: EP8 tests prove proxy spoof resistance, deterministic quotas and bounded keys, refusal ordering/no mutation, Retry-After, readiness non-disclosure, shutdown drain/idempotency/no fleet effects, and strict configuration
